result.reason: The redline reaches at least the fallback and materially approaches the preferred position: Affiliates and contractors are covered, their access is carved out from the third-party-access restriction, and the licence may transfer with an assignment permitted under Section (h), including an M&A successor. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated obligations. It does not clearly achieve the preferred durability standard because termination is governed by unseen Section 4 rather than expressly limited to uncured material breach, and no perpetual treatment is stated for any paid-up licence. Drafting is workable but awkwardly describes the licence as being “revocable” upon expiration or termination; stating that it “continues until” or “terminates upon” those events would be cleaner.
